_z4pro1: [haunted] After that night at the medium... I couldn't leave it alone. I needed to know what was happening to me.
_z4pro2: [weary] I went from shop to shop. Amulets, masters... anyone who might know something.
_z4pro3: [uneasy] One afternoon, on the top floor of an old mall, I found a shop I had never noticed before.
_z4pro4: [uneasy] Nobody else was up there... just an old song, coming from that shop.
_z4look1: [uneasy] Little bottles of oil... with something floating inside. I didn't want to know what.
_z4look2: [uneasy] Old photographs... nobody in them was smiling. And one of them had fresh flowers under it.
_z4look3: [unsettled] Red drinks, with straws in them... for someone who isn't here anymore.
_z4numb: [alarmed, strained] My arm... it's going numb...
_z4cold: [shivering, frightened] So cold... like ice water in my veins...
_z4beside: [frightened whisper] There's someone... standing beside me...
_z4yin: [shaken, sincere] I will not bring you home... but I will make merits under your name.
_yk4show: [an old woman, soft and slow, a little sad] This one is a Yin amulet. A young lady... she passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.
_to4notice: [an old uncle, warm and curious] You know... I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.
_z4tem1: [reflective] Later, I went to a temple and made a contribution dedicated to her.
_z4dedicate: [tender, reverent whisper] For the young lady of the amulet... may this merit reach you. May you be at peace.
_z4tem2: [reflective] That experience has stayed with me ever since.
_z4han0: [reflective] On another occasion... I was back at the shop I knew best.
_z4fine: [tired, sincere] I'm okay, Uncle. Still trying to understand what happened.
_z4urge: [terrified, straining] No... no... it wants to come in...
_z4go: [shaken, breathless] I... I have to go.
_z4hide: [breathless, ashamed] I couldn't let anyone see me like that. Not again. Not in public.
_z4tray0: [reflective] Eventually, there was one shop owner I visited often. He was the one who noticed.
_z4lersi: [awed, calm] Calm... and very old. Like sitting in a forest at night.
_z4wess: [awed, frightened] Something huge... standing right outside.
_z4naga: [awed, uneasy] Water... everywhere. And something moving in it.
_z4feel: [awed, frightened whisper] Everything went quiet. Even them.
_z4A1: [resolute] I wanted to know. So I opened myself... all the way.
_z4A1b: [panicking] No... this isn't one of them... this isn't—
_z4A2: [shaken] Twenty minutes... I couldn't remember any of it.
_z4A3: [haunted, reflective] I invited it in, to prove it was there. It came. And I still couldn't tell you what it was.
_z4A4: [haunted] For weeks after, I didn't feel alone. Not once.
_z4B1: [eager] How much, Uncle? I'll try it at home.
_z4B1b: [curious, uneasy] Okay... let's see what you are.
_z4B2: [frightened, guilty] I had told her I wouldn't bring her home. And here I was... bringing home something I couldn't even name.
_z4B3: [exhausted, haunted] I didn't sleep that night. Every sound in the room was it... or me.
_z4B4: [reflective] I brought it back the next morning. Some things are not for testing alone.
_z4C1: [polite, tired] Thank you, Uncle... but I think that's enough for today.
_z4C2: [reflective] I put it down and walked away. That much, I got right.
_z4C3: [troubled] But I still didn't understand what I had been doing... or what had been answering me.
_z4C4: [uneasy] And I knew... sooner or later, I would pick something up again.
_z4D1: [sincere] Uncle... I don't want to test them anymore. I don't know what I'm letting in.
_z4D2: [earnest] Do you know anyone who can teach me properly? Someone who really knows?
_z4D3: [resolved, reflective] Discernment. Respect. Proper guidance. That was the first time I asked for them.
_z4D4: [peaceful, certain] You don't need to invite something in... just to prove that something is there.
_z4A: [haunted] I opened the door to prove it was there. It came in.
_z4B: [regretful] I brought it home, and broke the promise I made to her.
_z4C: [uncertain] I put it down. I still didn't understand.
_z4D: [at peace] I stopped testing, and asked for a teacher.
